notes: 88-key hammer-action synthesizer/sampler workstation with built-in 16x3 audio/MIDI USB interface; no single category/type in the provided enum fits "synthesizer workstation" so category was set to "audio" and type omitted. Source is Roland's own current FANTOM-8 specifications page; the currently-shipping "FANTOM-8 EX" is confirmed (via Roland's fantom_8_ex product/spec pages and third-party coverage) to share identical rear-panel hardware I/O with the original FANTOM-8 — EX is a content/engine upgrade only. Caveats/inferences: (1) Roland's spec table does not state balanced vs. unbalanced for the 1/4" phone jacks (Main/Sub/Analog Filter Out); a MusicRadar review states these are "standard unbalanced connections," so they were mapped to ts-6.35 rather than trs-6.35. (2) CV Out / Gate Out jack size is not stated on Roland's page; these are commonly documented elsewhere as 1/8" mini jacks, mapped to the nearest available enum value trs-3.5, though electrically they are unbalanced mono TS control-voltage jacks, not stereo TRS audio — treat this port's connector as a low-confidence best fit. (3) Foot Pedal jacks (Hold, Ctrl1-3) are assumed 1/4" TRS per standard Roland convention for assignable pedal jacks; not explicitly typed in the spec table. (4) AC inlet type: Roland lists "Power Cord" as a separate included accessory (implying a detachable IEC cord rather than captive), but does not specify C13/C14; mapped to "iec". (5) No grade set on USB Computer port — Roland does not state USB 2.0 vs. higher speed. (6) No Ethernet/LAN port exists on this model. Mic/Line Input 1-2 are combo XLR/TRS jacks.
